Forge Steel Source Text:
When a creature takes the Charge main action, they move up to their speed in a straight line, then make a melee free strike against a target when they end their move. If the creature has an ability with the Charge keyword, they can use that ability against the target instead of a free strike.

A creature can’t move through difficult terrain or shift when they charge. They can fly or burrow as part of the Charge main action if they have that movement available to them, but they can’t climb or swim while charging unless they can automatically use that movement at full speed.

當你執行衝鋒主要動作時，你會以直線方式移動最多等於自身速度的距離，然後在移動結束時對 1 個目標發動 1 次近戰基礎打擊。若你擁有帶有「衝鋒」關鍵詞的招式，你也可以發動該招式來取代基礎打擊。

你在衝鋒期間無法穿越困難地形或進行遁移。若你擁有相應的移動能力，你可以在衝鋒期間飛行或掘地，但在衝鋒期間無法攀爬或游泳，除非你能夠自動以全速進行這類移動。

Forge Steel Source Text:
Many tests are maneuvers if made in combat. Searching a chest with a Reason test, picking a door’s lock with an Agility test, or lifting a portcullis with a Might test would all be maneuvers. Assisting a test is also a maneuver in combat.

Complex or time-consuming tests might require a main action if made in combat—or could take so long that they can’t be made during combat at all. Other tests that take no time at all, such as a Reason test to recall lore about mummies, are usually free maneuvers in combat. The Director has the final say regarding which tests can be made as maneuvers.
Forge Steel Target Text:
在戰鬥中，許多考驗都屬於機動動作。例如用理智考驗來搜索寶箱、用敏捷考驗來打開門鎖，或用力量考驗來抬起閘門等，都算是機動動作。在戰鬥中協助他人進行考驗同樣也是機動動作。

在戰鬥中，較複雜或耗時的考驗可能需要使用主要動作來執行，甚至可能耗時太久而根本無法在戰鬥中完成。另一方面，幾乎不花時間的考驗通常屬於免費機動動作（例如用理智考驗來回想木乃伊的相關知識）。哪些考驗可以作為機動動作進行，最終由導演決定。
Forge Steel Note: Forge Steel 刪去書上的「(see Assist a Test in Chapter 9: Tests)」；中文刪去「（詳見第 9 章〈考驗〉的「協助考驗（Assist a Test）」）」，不補字。「（例如用理智考驗來回想木乃伊的相關知識）」對應英文仍在的 such as 子句，保留。Q 已去掉 Forge Steel 原文開頭的換行（方案 A）。

Forge Steel Source Text:
Working with your Director, you can predetermine an encounter in which you will die. When that encounter begins, you become doomed. While doomed, you automatically obtain a tier 3 outcome on tests and ability rolls, and you don’t die no matter how low your Stamina falls. You then die immediately at the end of the encounter, and can’t be returned to life by any means.

If you don’t predetermine your death encounter, you can choose to become doomed while you are dying with the Director’s approval (no action required). Doing so should be reserved for encounters in which you are dying as a result of suitable heroism, such as making a last stand against a boss or saving civilians, or when the consequences of your actions have finally caught up to you — not because you’re playing a one-shot and have nothing to lose, Hacaarl.

Additionally, when your Stamina reaches the negative of your winded value and you are not doomed, you turn to rubble instead of experiencing death. You are unaware of your surroundings in this state, and you can’t regain Stamina or have this effect undone in any way. After 12 hours, you regain Stamina equal to your Recovery value.
Forge Steel Target Text:
與你的導演合作，你可以預先決定哪場遭遇你將會死亡。當該遭遇開始時，你會進入「命定」狀態。處於命定狀態時，你進行的任何考驗和招式檢定都會自動獲得 T3 結果，而且無論你的體力降到多低都不會死亡。然而，你會在遭遇結束時立刻死亡，而且無法透過任何方式復活。

若你沒有預先決定死亡遭遇，你也可以在陷入瀕死時進入命定狀態（無需動作，但需經導演同意）。這種選擇應該保留給因為英勇行為而瀕死的情況，例如與首領殊死一戰、拯救平民，或因為先前的行為而遭遇相應的後果，而不是單純因為你只玩一場冒險而沒有顧忌。

此外，若你的體力降至疲態值的負數，但未處於命定狀態，你會變成碎石，而非死亡。在這種情況下，你無法感知周圍環境，也無法以任何方式恢復體力或復原。在 12 小時後，你會恢復等於你復元值的體力。

Forge Steel Note: Forge Steel 族裔名稱為「Elf (high)」（書上為「High Elf」）；中文與書本相同。

Forge Steel Source Text: A magic glamor makes others perceive you as interesting and engaging. This glamor makes you appear and sound slightly different to each creature you meet, since what is engaging differs from creature to creature.
Forge Steel Target Text: 你的魔法魅力會讓人不自覺地被你吸引。由於每個人喜歡的特徵不盡相同，這種魔法魅力會讓你在每個生物眼中呈現出略為不同的外表與聲音。
Forge Steel Note: Forge Steel 把魅惑／遊說的氣場考驗優勢拆成 Roll Modifier 資料另外顯示；Forge Steel 英文也沒有書上最後一句，中文一併去掉。

Forge Steel Source Text: Whenever you take damage from a creature, you can use a triggered action to make that creature frightened of you until the end of their next turn.
Forge Steel Target Text: 每當你受到生物造成的傷害時，你可以使用反應動作讓該生物對你陷入畏縮狀態，直到他下個回合結束。
Forge Steel Note: 只留書本第 2 句規則段；一列只能有一個 Forge Steel 版，description 留英文（2026-10-07 已核准）。 Marc 於 2026-10-07「8-2 全照建議定稿」。

Forge Steel Source Text: Your mind allows you to maintain your focus in any situation.
Forge Steel Target Text: 你的心智能讓你在任何情況下保持專注。
Forge Steel Note: Forge Steel 用狀態免疫資料另外顯示暈眩免疫，這個名稱 P2-1 已經會顯示中文。

Forge Steel Source Text: Until the end of your next turn, you know the location of any supernatural object, undead, construct, or creature from another world within 5 squares, even if you don’t have line of effect to that object or creature. You know if you’re detecting an item or a creature, and you know the nature of any creature you detect.
Forge Steel Target Text: 直到你下個回合結束前，你知道 5 格內任何超常物體、亡靈、構裝體或異界生物的位置，即使你對他們沒有效果線也能如此。你能分辨偵測到的是物體還是生物，並且能知道那些生物的本質。
Forge Steel Note: 只留書本第 2、3 句；Forge Steel 英文另刪 or any，中文後文原樣保留。description 與書本用字不同，留英文。 Marc 於 2026-10-07「8-2 全照建議定稿」。

Forge Steel Note: Forge Steel 把耐力考驗優勢拆成 Roll Modifier 資料另外顯示，英文也沒有開頭那句；中文只留緩速那句，並去掉句首「此外，」。

Forge Steel Target Text: 堅持不懈

Forge Steel Source Text: Your connection to Axiom, the plane of Uttermost Law, allows you to manage chaos around you.

Forge Steel Note: 只留書本第 1 句；改寫的觸發句與文字段留英文。 Marc 於 2026-10-07「8-2 全照建議定稿」。

Forge Steel Source Text: Velloparatha - the worldsickness - might hinder, but you know how to turn your pain into something your enemies feel.
Forge Steel Target Text: 維洛帕拉症（俗稱躍界病）或許會妨礙你，但你也知道如何將自己的痛苦轉化為敵人能夠感受到的力量。

Forge Steel Target Text: 你血液中的魔力讓他人難以移動你。
Forge Steel Note: Forge Steel 把穩度 +1 拆成 Bonus 資料，另外顯示「Stability +1」。

Forge Steel Source Text: Your bloodfire supplies you with a constant rush of adrenaline.
Forge Steel Target Text: 你的血焰讓你的腎上腺素持續翻湧。
Forge Steel Note: Forge Steel 用狀態免疫資料另外顯示緩速免疫，這個名稱 P2-1 已經會顯示中文。

Forge Steel Source Text:
You flatten yourself into a shadow against a wall or floor you are touching, and become hidden from any creature you have cover or concealment from or who isn’t observing you. While in shadow form, you have full awareness of your surroundings, and strikes against you and tests made to search for you take a bane. You can’t move or be force moved, and you can’t take main actions or maneuvers except to exit this form or to direct creates under your control, such as one you summon using an ability. Any ability or effect that targets more than 1 square affects you in this form only if it explicitly affects the surface you are flattened against. You can exit this form as a maneuver.

If the surface you are flattened against is destroyed, this ability ends and you take 1d6 damage that can’t be reduced in any way.
Forge Steel Target Text:
你將自己化為平貼於牆面或地面的影子。此時，若你對 1 個生物具有掩護或遮蔽，或該生物觀察不到你，你就會對他處於隱藏。在影子形態中，你能完全感知周遭的環境，而且對你發動的任何打擊和搜索考驗都會承受 1 個劣勢。你無法移動或被強制移動，也無法執行主要動作和機動動作（除了脫離此形態或指揮受你控制的生物，例如你發動招式召喚的生物）。影響多格的招式或效果，只有在明確影響你所貼附的表面時，你才會受到影響。你可以使用機動動作脫離此形態。

若你所貼附的表面被摧毀，此招式會立刻終止，而且你會受到 1d6 點傷害（無法以任何方式減免）。
Forge Steel Note: Forge Steel 英文保留少 made、creatures 誤寫 creates、最後一句前多一個分段；Q 依 7-3 方案 A 去掉頭尾空白（守門比對忽略頭尾空白；enHash 仍取未去空白原文）。中文等於書本 Target Text，不刪字、不改寫。Marc 於 2026-10-07「8-2 全照建議定稿」。

Forge Steel Source Text: Your diminutive stature lets you easily get out of — or into — trouble.
Forge Steel Target Text: 你嬌小的身材能讓你更輕易地擺脫（或陷入）麻煩。
Forge Steel Note: Forge Steel 把體型 1S 拆成 Size 資料另外顯示。

Forge Steel Source Text: Courage is all you know.
Forge Steel Target Text: 你天生勇敢無懼。
Forge Steel Note: Forge Steel 用狀態免疫資料另外顯示畏縮免疫，這個名稱 P2-1 已經會顯示中文。

Forge Steel Source Text: Your small size makes it easier for you to slip away from the fray.
Forge Steel Target Text: 你矮小的體型能讓你更容易從混戰中溜走。
Forge Steel Note: Forge Steel 把撤離遁移 +1 拆成 Bonus 資料另外顯示。

Forge Steel Source Text: Staying light on your feet lets you quickly get back into position.
Forge Steel Target Text: 保持輕盈的步伐能讓你快速回到有利位置。
Forge Steel Note: 只留書本第 1 句；改寫的觸發句與文字段留英文。 Marc 於 2026-10-07「8-2 全照建議定稿」。

Forge Steel Source Text: The dead walk among us. Some of them are happier about it than others. Unlike the necromantic rituals that produce wights and wraiths and zombies, revenants rise from the grave through a combination of an unjust death and a burning desire for vengeance. Creatures sustained on pure will, they have no need of food or water or air - and, unlike their zombified cousins, they retain all their memories and personality from life.
Forge Steel Target Text: 死者行走在我們之間，但不是所有死者都樂於接受這種情況。不同於製造屍妖、怨靈和殭屍的死靈儀式，還魂屍是因為枉死與強烈的復仇心而從墳墓中爬出來。他們之所以能夠存在於世上，不是依靠食物、水或空氣，而是純粹的意志力。與殭屍不同的是，還魂屍保留了生前的所有記憶和個性。
Forge Steel Note: 多列合併：Forge Steel 的族裔描述＝書上 307＋308 兩列（破折號寫成 - 只是標點差異），中文為兩列原文相接。Basis Hash 只看 307；308 的 Target Text 若修改，這裡不會自動標成過期，要手動更新。

Forge Steel Source Text: When your Stamina reaches the negative of your winded value, you become inert instead of dying. You fall prone and can’t stand. You continue to observe your surroundings, but you can’t speak, take main actions, maneuvers, move actions, or triggered actions. While inert this way, if you take any fire damage, your body is destroyed and you die. Otherwise, after 12 hours, you regain Stamina equal to your recovery value.
Forge Steel Target Text: 當你的體力降至疲態值的負數時，你會陷入呆滯，而非死亡。你會伏地且無法起身。你能繼續觀察周圍環境，但無法說話，也無法執行主要動作、機動動作、移動動作和反應動作。在這種呆滯狀態下，若你受到任何火焰傷害，你的軀體就會被摧毀，你也會真正死亡。否則，在 12 小時後，你會恢復等於你復元值的體力。
Forge Steel Note: Forge Steel 只有書上第 2 段，開頭沒有 Additionally,；第 1 段（315）的免疫與弱點改用 Damage Modifier 資料顯示。中文去掉句首「此外，」。

Forge Steel Source Text: For you, an open wound is indistinguishable from a scratch.
Forge Steel Target Text: 對你而言，開放性傷口與輕微擦傷沒有區別。
Forge Steel Note: Forge Steel 用狀態免疫資料另外顯示流血免疫。

Forge Steel Source Text:
As a maneuver, you place a magic sigil on a creature within 10 squares of you. When you place a sigil, you can decide where it appears on the creature’s body, and whether the sigil is visible to only you or to all creatures.

You always know the direction to the exact location of a creature who bears one of your sigils and is on the same world. You can have an active number of sigils equal to your level, and can remove a sigil from a creature at will (no action required). If you already have the maximum number of sigils activated and you place a new one, your oldest sigil disappears with no other effect.
Forge Steel Target Text:
使用機動動作，你可以在 10 格內的 1 個生物身上放置 1 個魔法符印。放置符印時，你可以決定符印出現在生物身體的哪個位置，以及符印是只有你看得見，還是所有生物都看得見。

你始終知道相同世界中帶有你符印之生物的位置方向。你最多可以擁有數量等於你等級的符印，並且可以隨意解除生物身上的符印（無需動作）。若你在符印數量已滿的情況下放置新的符印，最舊的符印就會消失，不會產生任何效果。
Forge Steel Note: 多列合併：Forge Steel 的 Vengeance Mark 描述＝書上 329＋330 兩段，中文為兩段原文相接、中間空一行；英文另有小用字差異（of you、can decide、an active number of sigils），中文照原文。Q 已去掉 Forge Steel 原文開頭的換行（方案 A）。Basis Hash 只看 329；330 的 Target Text 若修改，這裡不會自動標成過期，要手動更新。

Forge Steel Source Text: While on a dangerous espionage assignment, things went sideways. Although you escaped with your life, the mission was a public failure thanks to bad information your agency gave you. They denied you work for them, and you went on the run. Hero work will let you survive and clear your name.
Forge Steel Target Text: 在一次危險的間諜任務中，事情出了差錯。你雖然保住了性命，但由於機構提供的情報有誤，任務的失敗也公諸於世。機構否認你曾為他們工作，迫使你開始逃亡。成為英雄不僅能讓你維持生計，還能幫你洗清名譽。
Forge Steel Note: Forge Steel English exactly matches the Book source; the APPROVED Book target is reused verbatim.

Forge Steel Source Text: Disavowed
Forge Steel Target Text: 被迫除名
Forge Steel Note: Forge Steel English exactly matches the Book source; the APPROVED Book target is reused verbatim.

Forge Steel Source Text: Your identity was always hidden. It was your way of protecting those around you because the work you did spying on powerful entities came with dangers. Then your world came crashing down when an enemy agent unmasked you, causing you to lose everything - your privacy, livelihood, loved ones, all gone in the blink of an eye. Instead of going into hiding, you became a public hero to protect the innocent in the name of those you lost.
Forge Steel Target Text: 監視大人物的工作充滿危險，你始終隱藏自己的身分，這是你保護親朋好友的方式。但一名敵方特務揭穿了你的身分，你的世界就此崩塌，你的隱私、生計、摯愛，一瞬間全都消失了。面對這樣的打擊，你沒有選擇躲藏，而是成為一名公開的英雄，以逝者之名保護無辜者。
Forge Steel Note: Forge Steel English differs from the Book source; live website text is preserved exactly and the APPROVED Book target is reused after meaning alignment.

Forge Steel Source Text: Faceless
Forge Steel Target Text: 揭露身分
Forge Steel Note: Forge Steel English exactly matches the Book source; the APPROVED Book target is reused verbatim.

Forge Steel Source Text: There was a time in your life when you used to sell information to the highest bidder. Your acts were unsanctioned by any one organization, but you were well-connected enough to trade in secrets. Politics never mattered much to you until the information you sold wound up causing a ripple effect of harm that eventually destroyed the place you once called home. You became a hero to make up for your past.
Forge Steel Target Text: 你曾經將情報賣給出價最高的買家。你不隸屬於任何組織，但憑藉廣闊的人脈進行情報交易。政治曾對你毫無意義，直到你販賣的情報引發了連鎖反應，最終摧毀你視為家園的地方。你成為英雄，就是為了彌補過去的錯誤。
Forge Steel Note: Forge Steel English exactly matches the Book source; the APPROVED Book target is reused verbatim.

Forge Steel Source Text: Free Agent
Forge Steel Target Text: 自由特務
Forge Steel Note: Forge Steel English exactly matches the Book source; the APPROVED Book target is reused verbatim.

Forge Steel Source Text: After years of cultivating a rich list of informants, one of those informants risked everything to expose the heinous plans of powerful individuals. You promised to protect your informant, but your agency left them hanging - literally. You cut ties with your employer and swore to always make good on your word as a hero.
Forge Steel Target Text: 在多年培養大量的線人名單後，其中一位冒著生命危險揭露了權貴的邪惡計畫。你承諾保護這位線人，但你的機構卻背棄了他，任由他被吊死。你因此與雇主徹底斷絕關係，並立誓成為一名英雄，永遠信守自己的承諾。
Forge Steel Note: Forge Steel English differs from the Book source; live website text is preserved exactly and the APPROVED Book target is reused after meaning alignment.

Forge Steel Source Text: Informed
Forge Steel Target Text: 線人情報
Forge Steel Note: Forge Steel English exactly matches the Book source; the APPROVED Book target is reused verbatim.

Forge Steel Source Text: While embedded in an undercover assignment, you fell for someone on the other side. They discovered you were a double-agent and though you insisted your feelings were real, the deceit cut too deep for your love interest to ignore. They exposed you, spurned you, or died because of their closeness to you. You left the espionage business to become a hero with nothing to hide.
Forge Steel Target Text: 在執行臥底任務時，你愛上了對方陣營的某人。當他發現你是雙重間諜時，即使你真誠地表明自己的真實感情，但這種欺騙對你的愛人來說傷害太深，無法被原諒。他可能因此揭發了你的身分、拒絕你的愛，或因為你的關係而喪命。這段經歷讓你決定離開間諜事業，轉而成為一名不再需要隱藏真實自我的英雄。
Forge Steel Note: Forge Steel English differs from the Book source; live website text is preserved exactly and the APPROVED Book target is reused after meaning alignment.

Forge Steel Source Text: Spies and Lovers
Forge Steel Target Text: 間諜與情人
Forge Steel Note: Forge Steel English exactly matches the Book source; the APPROVED Book target is reused verbatim.

Forge Steel Source Text: You spent your life in service of your country or an organization that upheld your values. During your undercover operations, you discovered everything you were told was a lie. Whether you confronted your superiors or were exposed, you were stripped of your service medals before you left to become a true hero.
Forge Steel Target Text: 你畢生都為祖國或與你價值觀相符的組織服務。在執行臥底任務期間，你發現你所知的一切都是謊言。無論你是質問上級，還是身分曝光，在你離開並成為真正的英雄之前，你的功勳獎章全都被剝奪了。

Forge Steel Source Text: When you entered adulthood, you heard unsavory whispers about your family’s fortune before learning that their wealth came at the cost of others’ suffering. Whether you shed light on the secret or not, you left to become a hero stripped of noble title.
Forge Steel Target Text: 在你成年後，你聽聞關於家族財富的不光彩傳言，後來發現這些財富確實建立在他人的痛苦之上。不管你是否選擇揭露這個祕密，你最終都離開了家族，成為一位失去貴族頭銜的英雄。
Forge Steel Note: Forge Steel English exactly matches the Book source; the APPROVED Book target is reused verbatim.

Forge Steel Source Text: Through some treasure or innate ability, you were able to defraud other aristocrats. You did it for fun. When you were found out, you lost your status. Whether you served time or escaped from punishment, you decided to rehabilitate yourself and became a hero.
Forge Steel Target Text: 無論是藉由超自然力量還是天生的說服技巧，你成功欺騙了其他貴族，而且你是純粹為了樂趣而這麼做。當行為敗露後，你喪失了貴族身分。不管最終是服刑還是逃過懲罰，你決定洗心革面，成為一位英雄。
